name: Gakuen Alice ~WakuWaku★Happy Friends~
original_name: 学園アリス～わくわく★ハッピーフレンズ～
source: There are rumors that Gakuen Alice will disappear. In order to prevent this, we will save money in the piggy bank. The method of saving is to synthesize items collected in forests, create items, and submit them to the auction. All items that can be synthesized are specially made by firefly. You can make ketchup bullets, Pigler No. 3, pengie badges, etc. that appear in the original. You can make many other items without getting bored. There are events from previous GBA game such as the Kurigo rice competition as well.
translation: 有传言说，爱丽丝学园即将消失。为了阻止这件事发生，大家要往存钱罐里攒钱。赚钱的方法是将在森林等地收集到的材料合成为物品，再拿去拍卖。所有能够合成的物品都是萤的特制发明。你可以制作原作中出现过的番茄酱子弹、小猪机器人3号、企鹅徽章等物品，还有许多其他物品可供制作，让人乐此不疲。游戏还收录了前作GBA游戏中的栗子饭争夺赛等活动。
